subject: DI05019021

title.en: 2.1 IC Engine Fuels — introduction and classification
title.gu: 2.1 IC એન્જિનનાં ઇંધણો — પરિચય અને Classification

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify by chemical family, physical form or source; state the basis before listing examples.

Understand why

Alcohols:ethanol, methanol; gaseous fuels:CNG, LPG, biogas, hydrogen; bio-derived fuels:biodiesel, bioethanol, biomethane.

These groups overlap:bioethanol is both an alcohol and a biofuel. Hydrogen production decides its upstream emissions.

Compare calorific value, ignition quality, air requirement, storage, materials, cost and total emissions—not only tailpipe appearance.

Is every gaseous fuel renewable?

No. Physical form does not establish the source.

Is octane number a heating-value rating?

No. It rates specified SI knock resistance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Chemical family,physical form,source મુજબ classify કરો;examples પહેલાં basis લખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Alcohols:ethanol,methanol;gaseous:CNG,LPG,biogas,hydrogen;bio-derived:biodiesel,bioethanol,biomethane.

Groups overlap:bioethanol alcohol અને biofuel બન્ને છે.Hydrogen productionથી upstream emissions નક્કી થાય.

Calorific value,ignition quality,air requirement,storage,materials,cost,total emissions compare કરો;ફક્ત tailpipe દેખાવ નહિ.

દરેક Gaseous Fuel Renewable છે?

ના.Physical formથી source સાબિત નહિ.

Octane Number Heating-value Rating છે?

ના.Specified SI knock resistance બતાવે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Alcohols are oxygen-containing fuels used in approved blends or dedicated compatible engines.

Understand why

High knock resistance can suitSIoperation; lower energy per unit fuel volume than petrol changes consumption and calibration.

Water absorption, material compatibility, cold-start behaviour and fuel-system design must be checked.

Methanol is highly toxic; ethanol and methanol are not interchangeable merely because both are alcohols.

Renewability depends on feedstock/energy pathway; do not infer zero lifecycle carbon from the name bioethanol.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Alcohols oxygen-containing fuels છે;approved blends/compatible dedicated enginesમાં વપરાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

High knock resistance SI માટે useful;petrol કરતાં lower energy/volumeથી consumption,calibration બદલાય.

Water absorption,material compatibility,cold-start behaviour,fuel-system design તપાસો.

Methanol highly toxic છે;બન્ને alcohol હોવા છતાં interchangeable નથી.

Renewability feedstock/energy pathway પર;bioethanol નામથી zero lifecycle carbon નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Hydrogen can power a suitableICengine or a fuel-cell system; these conversions are different.

Understand why

High gravimetric energy but low ambient volumetric energy makes storage important; gas displaces some intake air in port-fed engines.

Fast flame propagation, wide flammability and low ignition energy require careful combustion and leak-control design.

Hydrogen contains no carbon, but a H2ICEcan formNOx from hot air; production and lubricant effects still matter.

A fuel cell converts chemical energy electrochemically; it does not burn fuel in an engine cylinder.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Hydrogen suitable IC engine કે fuel-cell system ચલાવે;બન્ને conversion જુદાં છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

High energy/mass,low ambient energy/volumeથી storage મહત્વનું;port-fed engineમાં gas intake airનો ભાગ બદલે.

Fast flame propagation,wide flammability,low ignition energy માટે careful combustion/leak-control design.

Hydrogenમાં carbon નથી,પણ H2 ICE hot airથી NOx બનાવી શકે;production,lubricant effects હજી મહત્વના.

Fuel cell electrochemically chemical energy ફેરવે;engine cylinderમાં fuel burn કરતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

LPG is mainly propane/butane; CNG is natural gas, mainly methane, stored compressed.

Understand why

LPG is liquefied under appropriate pressure; CNG normally stays a compressed gas at ambient storage temperature.

Both need approved fuel systems and metering suited to their properties; one regulator/tank is not a substitute for the other.

LPG vapour commonly accumulates low; H2 and methane tend to rise in free air, though confinement can still trap dangerous mixtures.

Cleaner combustion in a suitable system is not zero emissions; storage, supply chain and methane leakage must be considered.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

LPG મુખ્યત્વે propane/butane;CNG mainly methane natural gas,compressed storage.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

LPG appropriate pressureમાં liquid બને;ambient storage temperatureમાં CNG compressed gas રહે.

બન્નેને approved system,suitable metering જોઈએ;એકનું regulator/tank બીજાનું substitute નહિ.

LPG vapour સામાન્ય રીતે નીચે ભેગું થાય;H2,methane free airમાં ઉપર જાય,પણ confined spaceમાં dangerous mixture trap થઈ શકે.

Suitable systemમાં cleaner combustion એટલે zero emission નહિ;storage,supply chain,methane leakage જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Biogas is a digestion-derived gas mixture; biofuel is a wider source-based family.

Understand why

Raw biogas mainly contains methane andCO2, with variable moisture, H2S and traces; cleaning/conditioning must match equipment requirements.

Upgraded biomethane is not the same composition as untreated biogas; lower methane fraction lowers useful heating value.

Biodiesel is an approved fatty-acid-ester fuel/blend, not simply raw vegetable oil; viscosity, oxidation and cold-flow properties matter.

Waste/feedstock availability, land use, water, processing and lifecycle emissions decide sustainability.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Biogas digestion-derived gas mixture;biofuel source-based મોટો family છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Raw biogasમાં mainly methane,CO2;variable moisture,H2S,traces;cleaning/conditioning equipment મુજબ.

Upgraded biomethane untreated biogas સમાન composition નથી;ઓછું methane heating value ઘટાડે.

Biodiesel approved fatty-acid-ester fuel/blend છે,raw vegetable oil નહિ;viscosity,oxidation,cold-flow મહત્વના.

Waste/feedstock availability,land use,water,processing,lifecycle emissions sustainability નક્કી કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Follow the functional path:certified storage → protected isolation → pressure control → metered engine supply.

Classification / types — basis first

  • By delivery:older mixer systems and electronically controlled gas-injection systems; by fuel mode:dedicated CNG, bi-fuel SI and suitable dual-fuel CI are different arrangements. The following is a conceptual gas-injection path.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Certified cylinder bank and secure mountings contain compressed gas; they are selected and inspected for the approved vehicle system.
  2. Cylinder valves, shut-off/isolation and approved pressure protection control storage access and abnormal conditions.
  3. Rated high-pressure pipes and fittings carry gas to a compatible regulator; they are not ordinary petrol hoses.
  4. Regulator stages reduce pressure to the engine delivery requirement; filters and thermal arrangements follow the system design.
  5. Gas rail/injectors or mixer meter gas; ECU, sensors and changeover logic where fitted coordinate delivery and protection.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Authorised operation enables fuel flow through approved valves and isolation hardware.
  2. Gas passes through rated lines to the regulator, where controlled pressure reduction occurs.
  3. Filtering and designed conditioning prepare the gas for metering; regulator operation is not the same as changing cylinder storage pressure.
  4. ECU/metering supplies the required gas for air admission and load; SI combustion still needs timed ignition.
  5. Monitoring and designed shut-off logic respond to faults/stop conditions; actual checks use authorised procedures, not a classroom filling sequence.

Application / advantages

CNG fuel requires pressure reduction, compatible metering, leak control and suitable calibration; cleaner combustion is not zero lifecycle emissions.

Common mistake / conditions

No DIY conversion, non-rated adapters or flame leak tests; storage inspection and servicing belong to authorised personnel.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Functional path:certified storage → protected isolation → pressure control → metered engine supply.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Delivery મુજબ older mixer,electronic gas injection;fuel mode મુજબ dedicated CNG,bi-fuel SI,suitable dual-fuel CI જુદાં.નીચે conceptual gas-injection path.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Certified cylinder bank,secure mountings compressed gas રાખે;approved vehicle system મુજબ selection,inspection.
  2. Cylinder valves,shut-off/isolation,approved pressure protection storage access,abnormal conditions control કરે.
  3. Rated high-pressure pipes/fittings gas compatible regulator સુધી;ordinary petrol hoses નહિ.
  4. Regulator stages pressureને delivery requirement સુધી ઘટાડે;filters,thermal arrangements design મુજબ.
  5. Gas rail/injectors અથવા mixer gas meter કરે;ECU,sensors,changeover logic delivery,protection coordinate કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Authorised operationમાં approved valves/isolationથી flow enable થાય.
  2. Gas rated linesથી regulatorમાં,controlled pressure reduction થાય.
  3. Filtering,conditioning gasને metering માટે તૈયાર કરે;regulation cylinder storage pressure બદલવા સમાન નથી.
  4. ECU/metering air,load મુજબ gas આપે;SI combustionમાં timed ignition હજી જોઈએ.
  5. Monitoring,shut-off logic faults/stopને respond કરે;actual checks authorised proceduresથી,classroom filling sequenceથી નહિ.

Application / લાભ

CNGને pressure reduction,compatible metering,leak control,calibration;cleaner combustion zero lifecycle emission નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

DIY conversion,non-rated adapters,flame leak tests નહિ;storage inspection,service authorised personnelનું કામ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a vapour-feed example, a rated tank feeds controlled vapour through a vaporiser/regulator to metering.

Classification / types — basis first

  • By phase delivered:vapour-feed and liquid-injection LPG systems. By fuel mode:dedicated or approved bi-fuel systems. The vaporiser description applies to vapour-feed, not every LPG design.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Approved LPG tank stores a liquid/vapour inventory with the designed expansion space and mountings.
  2. Multivalve/approved valve assembly incorporates the specified isolation, filling and protection functions; these are not improvised domestic-cylinder fittings.
  3. Rated liquid supply line and shut-off carry LPG to filter and pressure-control equipment.
  4. Vaporiser/regulator receives heat as required to vaporise fuel and regulate vapour delivery pressure.
  5. Mixer or gas injectors, ECU/sensors and intake hardware meter fuel to the compatible engine; liquid-injection designs use different conditioning equipment.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Tank and shut-off deliver LPG through the approved supply path when operation is permitted.
  2. In a vapour-feed system, liquid reaching the vaporiser absorbs heat and changes to vapour.
  3. Regulation lowers and stabilises delivery pressure within the specified design; heat input prevents unsuitable vaporisation conditions.
  4. Metering matches vapour fuel to admitted air and engine demand; the prepared charge burns in the suitable SI engine.
  5. Approved shutdown stops supply; leak management must consider that LPG vapour can collect in low or poorly ventilated areas.

Application / advantages

LPG offers compact liquid storage and good SI knock resistance; the engine and supply equipment must be approved for the fuel.

Common mistake / conditions

No domestic-cylinder substitutions, home vaporiser construction or filling instructions are provided. Material compatibility and vapour accumulation are essential safety issues.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Vapour-feed exampleમાં rated tankથી vaporiser/regulator,પછી meteringને controlled vapour મળે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Delivered phase મુજબ vapour-feed/liquid-injection;fuel mode મુજબ dedicated/approved bi-fuel.Vaporiser description vapour-feed માટે,દરેક LPG design માટે નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Approved tankમાં designed expansion space,mountings સાથે liquid/vapour રહે.
  2. Multivalve/approved assembly specified isolation,filling,protection આપે;domestic-cylinder fittings substitute નહિ.
  3. Rated liquid line,shut-off LPGને filter,pressure-control સુધી લાવે.
  4. Vaporiser/regulatorને જરૂરી heat મળે જેથી fuel vaporise,delivery pressure regulate થાય.
  5. Mixer/gas injectors,ECU/sensors,intake hardware metering કરે;liquid-injectionમાં conditioning જુદી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Operation permitted હોય ત્યારે tank,shut-off approved pathથી LPG આપે.
  2. Vapour-feedમાં vaporiserએ liquid heat લઈ vapour બને.
  3. Regulation delivery pressure ઘટાડે,stable રાખે;heat inputથી unsuitable vaporisation ટળે.
  4. Metering vapour fuelને air,demand મુજબ આપે;charge suitable SI engineમાં burn થાય.
  5. Approved shutdown supply રોકે;LPG vapour low/poorly ventilated areasમાં ભેગું થઈ શકે તે ધ્યાનમાં લો.

Application / લાભ

LPG compact liquid storage,સારી SI knock resistance આપે;engine,supply equipment approved હોવા જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Domestic cylinder substitution,home vaporiser/filling instructions નથી.Material compatibility,vapour accumulation safety issues છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Octane number rates resistance to end-gas knock in a specifiedSItest; it is not calorific value.

Understand why

Conventional primary references assign n-heptane0 and iso-octane100; equivalent knock behaviour establishes the scale within its conventional range.

A rating of90does not prove the commercial fuel chemically contains90% iso-octane.

RON andMONuse different prescribed test conditions; state the quoted rating rather than treating all pump labels as identical.

Higher octane permits knock-resistant operation in a suitably designed/calibrated engine; it does not automatically increase power in every engine.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Specified SI testમાં end-gas knock resistanceનું rating octane number;calorific value નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Conventional primary references:n-heptane0,iso-octane100;equivalent knock behaviourથી scale મળે.

Rating90એ commercial fuelમાં chemically90% iso-octane હોવાનો પુરાવો નથી.

RON,MONની prescribed conditions જુદી;quoted rating લખો,બધા labels same નહિ.

Higher octane suitable design/calibrationમાં knock resistance આપે;દરેક engineમાં power આપમેળે નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Cetane number rates diesel autoignition quality under a specified test; higher generally means shorter ignition delay.

Understand why

The conventional scale uses cetane(n-hexadecane)100; modern reference blends use prescribed low-cetane components. Historical alpha-methylnaphthalene was assigned0.

Do not mix the old reference definition with a claim that every current laboratory uses the historical substance.

Cetane rating and cetane index are not identical:the index is an estimation based on specified fuel properties.

Octane resists unwantedSIautoignition; cetane promotes timelyCIautoignition. They serve different needs.

Is higher octane the goal for diesel ignition?

No. Use the specified diesel ignition-quality requirements.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Specified testમાં diesel autoignition qualityનું rating cetane number;વધારે એટલે સામાન્ય રીતે shorter ignition delay.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Conventional scaleમાં cetane(n-hexadecane)100;modern reference blends prescribed low-cetane components લે.Historical alpha-methylnaphthalene0 હતું.

જૂની reference definition પરથી દરેક current lab historical substance વાપરે એવો દાવો નહિ.

Cetane rating,index identical નહિ;index specified propertiesથી estimate છે.

Octane unwanted SI autoignition resist કરે;cetane timely CI autoignitionને support કરે;needs જુદી.

Diesel Ignition માટે Higher Octane Goal છે?

ના.Specified diesel ignition-quality requirements લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Identify the emitted species before choosing its control.

Understand why

CO reduces blood oxygen-carrying ability; HC contributes to smog and some species are toxic; NOx irritates respiratory systems and contributes to smog.

Particulate harms respiratory/cardiovascular health; SOx relates to fuel sulphur; CO2 contributes to climate change.

Correct combustion/maintenance, appropriateEGR, catalyst, DPF andSCRcontrol different species under suitable operating conditions.

Fresh-air ventilation prevents exposure but does not replace emission compliance; never run engines in enclosed occupied spaces.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Control પહેલાં emitted species ઓળખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

CO bloodની oxygen-carrying ability ઘટાડે;HC smogમાં ફાળો,કેટલાક toxic;NOx respiratory irritation,smog કરે.

Particulate respiratory/cardiovascular healthને હાનિ;SOx fuel sulphur સાથે;CO2 climate changeમાં ફાળો.

Correct combustion/maintenance,suitable EGR,catalyst,DPF,SCR અલગ speciesને suitable conditionsમાં control કરે.

Ventilation exposure ઘટાડે પણ compliance substitute નહિ;enclosed occupied spaceમાં engine run નહિ.

h.en: 2.3.2 Emission norms:what to write in an exam

body.en:
Definition / principle

Norms specify regulated species, limits, test procedures, vehicle/engine categories and compliance requirements.

Understand why

India uses Bharat Stage emission standards for relevant vehicle categories; BSVI is an example framework, not one universal limit for all engines.

Limits may be expressedg/km or g/kWh depending on category/testing; never compare unlike units directly.

Type-approval laboratory/real-driving requirements, OBD and in-use checks have different roles; PUC is not a replacement for full type approval.

For exact current legal limits cite the applicable notification, vehicle class, fuel and date; these notes do not invent a universal threshold table.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Norms regulated species,limits,test procedures,categories,compliance નક્કી કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Indiaમાં relevant categories માટે Bharat Stage standards;BSVI framework છે,બધા engines માટે એક limit નહિ.

Category/test મુજબ g/km કે g/kWh;unlike units સીધી compare નહિ.

Type-approval lab/real-driving requirements,OBD,in-use checksની roles જુદી;PUC full type approvalનું substitute નહિ.

Exact current legal limits માટે applicable notification,class,fuel,date જોઈએ;અહીં universal threshold table બનાવેલ નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

E20is petrol containing20% ethanol by volume with about80% petrol; the syllabus word bending is read as blending.

Understand why

Oxygen content and high knock resistance affect combustion, while lower fuel energy per litre can affect volumetric consumption.

Fuel-system materials, calibration, starting and approved compatibility must be checked against the vehicle manufacturer requirements.

Emission changes depend on engine and pollutant; avoid promising lower every emission, unchanged mileage or universal compatibility.

This is a definition/analysis topic, not instructions for home blending or changing a vehicle fuel system.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

E20માં volume પ્રમાણે20% ethanol,લગભગ80% petrol;syllabusનું bending એટલે blending.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Oxygen content,high knock resistance combustion બદલે;lower energy/litreથી volumetric consumption બદલાય.

Materials,calibration,starting,approved compatibility manufacturer મુજબ તપાસો.

Emission changes engine,pollutant મુજબ;બધા emissions ઓછાં,mileage unchanged,universal compatibilityની promise નહિ.

આ definition/analysis topic છે,home blending કે vehicle modification instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The owner syllabus jumps from2.3to2.6; retain that numbering.

Understand why

Orsat-type analysis determines selected dry-gas components by sequential absorption, commonlyCO2, O2, CO; remaining gas is inferred with stated assumptions.

Electronic analysers may measureCO, CO2, HC, O2, NOx according to instrument capability; smoke opacity/particle measurements are separate.

Sample integrity, leaks, condensation, calibration, zero/span and dry/wet basis affect results; write instrument units such asvolume% orppm.

HighCOcan indicate incomplete combustion; highO2may indicate excess air or a leak; diagnosis needs operating conditions and several readings.

Never fabricate observations or handle absorption chemicals/exhaust without approved laboratory controls.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Orsat-typeમાં sequential absorptionથી selected dry components,સામાન્ય CO2,O2,CO;બાકી gas stated assumptionsથી inferred.

Electronic analyser capability મુજબ CO,CO2,HC,O2,NOx;smoke opacity/particle measurement અલગ.

Sample integrity,leaks,condensation,calibration,zero/span,dry/wet basis result બદલે;volume%/ppm units લખો.

Observations fabricate નહિ;approved lab controls વગર chemicals/exhaust handle નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Orsat apparatus estimates selected exhaust-gas volume fractions by measuring volume reduction after selective absorption.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Exhaust analysis methods include volumetric chemical absorption, selective electronic gas analysers, and separate smoke/particulate measurements. Orsat measures selected dry-gas volume fractions, not every pollutant.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Graduated gas burette measures sample volume; an enclosing water jacket limits temperature variation during comparison.
  2. A levelling bottle adjusts liquid levels and permits volume readings at a controlled comparison pressure.
  3. Absorption pipettes contain selective reagents:conventional CO2 absorption uses caustic solution, O2 uses an appropriate alkaline absorbent, and CO uses a suitable cuprous reagent under laboratory controls.
  4. Stopcocks and connecting capillaries direct the sample; leak-tight connections and correct dead-space handling are essential.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. An authorised laboratory conditions the representative sample on the specified dry basis and establishes an initial volume at defined temperature/pressure.
  2. Selective absorption removes a component; the remaining volume is compared under the same reference conditions.
  3. Volume reduction divided by original sample volume gives that component's volume fraction after suitable complete selective absorption.
  4. Sequential CO2, O2 and CO determinations use the proper method and order; remaining gas is inferred under stated assumptions, not directly proven to be pure nitrogen.
  5. Check repeatability, leakage and dry/wet basis before interpreting combustion; modern analysers separately detect only the species for which they are designed.

Application / advantages

Explains dry volumetric exhaust analysis. For a100mL original sample and12mL selective CO2 reduction, the illustrative CO2 reading is12% by volume.

Common mistake / conditions

Reagents and exhaust are hazardous; this is method theory, not a chemical preparation/handling recipe. No observations are claimed.

Does an analyser reading prove a diagnosis alone?

No. Check calibration, conditions, leaks and measurement basis.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Orsat apparatus selective absorption પછી volume reduction માપી selected exhaust-gas volume fractions ગણે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Methods volumetric chemical absorption,selective electronic analysers,separate smoke/particulate measurements.Orsat selected dry-gas volume fractions માપે,દરેક pollutant નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Graduated burette sample volume માપે;water jacket comparisonમાં temperature variation મર્યાદિત કરે.
  2. Levelling bottle liquid levels adjust કરે,controlled comparison pressureએ reading આપે.
  3. Absorption pipettesમાં selective reagents;conventional CO2 માટે caustic solution,O2 માટે suitable alkaline absorbent,CO માટે suitable cuprous reagent—laboratory controls હેઠળ.
  4. Stopcocks,capillaries sample દોરે;leak-tight connections,correct dead-space handling જરૂરી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Authorised laboratory representative sampleને specified dry basisમાં condition કરી defined temperature/pressureએ initial volume લે.
  2. Selective absorption component દૂર કરે;remaining volume same reference conditionsમાં compare થાય.
  3. Suitable complete selective absorption પછી volume reduction/original volumeથી component fraction મળે.
  4. Proper method/orderથી CO2,O2,CO નક્કી થાય;remaining gas assumptionsથી inferred,શુદ્ધ nitrogen સીધું prove નથી થતું.
  5. Interpretation પહેલાં repeatability,leakage,dry/wet basis તપાસો;modern analyser ફક્ત designed species detect કરે.

Application / લાભ

Dry volumetric analysis સમજાવે.Original sample100mL,selective CO2 reduction12mL હોય તો illustrative CO2 reading volume પ્રમાણે12%.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Reagents,exhaust hazardous;આ method theory છે,chemical preparation/handling recipe નહિ.Observationsનો દાવો નથી.

ફક્ત Analyser Readingથી Diagnosis પાકું?

ના.Calibration,conditions,leaks,measurement basis જુઓ.
